mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 44 degrees at Verona City Hall, with a New Moon phase tonight.

The City of Verona has announced that the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project is underway, involving essential updates to water mains, storm sewers, and the installation of new concrete sidewalks and driveways to improve local infrastructure.

We have plenty of fun on the horizon, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old Verona man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
